defect.reproducer: On branch defect/pr06-lidar-parent (commit 8eb7c525c9d680fe8cf23cab9b44f38a4f31b39a) lidar_link gets camera_link as parent instead of base_link, offset unchanged. check_urdf and the structure check still succeed; `ros2 run tf2_ros tf2_echo base_link lidar_link` reports translation [0.560, 0.000, 0.760] instead of [0.280, 0.000, 0.380], and test_every_link_has_the_expected_parent and test_frame_position_in_base_link[lidar_link] fail (evidence/pr06/defect-*.txt, red CI run 41011891857).
defect.root_cause: A fixed joint offset is relative to its parent frame. With camera_link as parent the lidar offset is added to the camera pose (0.28, 0, 0.38), giving (0.56, 0, 0.76). The tree stays connected and acyclic, so a structural check cannot see the mistake: only a check of the expected parent and of the resulting position can.
defect.proof_after: With the parent restored to base_link the same tests pass (21 passed, 1 skipped), check_urdf shows lidar_link as a child of base_link, and tf2_echo base_link lidar_link returns [0.280, 0.000, 0.380] (evidence/pr06/fixed-*.txt).
